newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold demand rises as prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold demand rises as prices fall.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume rose to 1,954 kilos on Wednesday, from Tuesday's 1,246 kilos as lower prices encouraged demand, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $342.00 an ounce and 1,571,000 lira per gram, compared to $343.90 and 1,574,000 lira on Tuesday, following lower levels on European markets.
"The day's lower prices meant an increase in demand both from the banks and the free market which is now gearing up for the summer seasonal demand," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira fell to 142,510 lira to the dollar versus the previous 142,030, softening the fall in gold's lira value.
Most of the the day's trade -- 1,095 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 64.7 percent of trade conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
